root_idea.summary: The root centers on taking one thing into the responsibility, support, or sufficiency of another.
root_idea.development: The semantic development is associated with a cloth or support wrapped around a camel's hump or rump to carry a rider. From this image arise the branches of undertaking responsibility, guardianship, suretyship, an apportioned share, and a carried or burdensome consequence.

senses.definition: To undertake responsibility for a person and provide care or guardianship.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrences are person-directed and present the undertaking as taking charge of, nursing, or rearing the dependent.

senses.definition: To place or assign a person under another's care by making that other person responsible for them.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passage concerning Mary, the doubled reading presents Zakariya as made responsible for her; the reported alternative reading has Zakariya himself undertaking her care. These reading differences are kept as a constructional nuance rather than separate lexical senses.

senses.definition: To make someone a responsible party for another person; hence, to entrust that person to them.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic appeal, the speaker asks to be made her kafil, that is, to be entrusted with her care or responsibility.

senses.definition: A guarantor, surety, or sponsor who assumes responsibility for another.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence uses the noun in the construction of making God a guarantor or surety over a covenant.

senses.definition: A share or portion allotted from an act, bounty, or recompense.
senses.usage_conditions: In 57:28, كِفْلَيْنِ is explained as two portions of mercy or bounty, associated with this world and the next, or as a continuing blessing sufficient for one's needs. The share accruing from beneficial intercession in 4:85 is included in this branch.

senses.definition: A burdensome or adverse consequence incurred through joining another in a wrongful act or intercession.
senses.usage_conditions: In 4:85, this is treated as a figurative extension distinct from the ordinary share sense: supporting a bad act brings the participant a corresponding hardship or liability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assume legal responsibility for property, or to stand surety for a person's appearance or answerability in a suit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the legal guarantee construction, including responsibility for what another person owes or for that person's presence before a claimant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Suretyship: the joining of one's liability to another person's liability so that one becomes answerable for what the other owes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A formal responsibility or guarantee relation, equivalent to ضَمَان in the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hinder part of the body: the buttocks, rump, or rear portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily noun distinct from the responsibility and suretyship branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman with a large hinder part or buttocks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized descriptive noun is explicitly associated with the كَفَل, the rear portion of the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Guaranteed, pledged, or secured through an acknowledged assumption of responsibility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive description of property or an obligation for which responsibility has been undertaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloth or riding support wrapped around a camel's hump or rump, with its ends tied so that a rider may be carried.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This concrete support image is part of the root's classical lexical development and is not asserted as the direct sense of the Quranic common-noun occurrences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cowardly man who remains at the rear of battle, chiefly intent on withdrawal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage likening the man to a carried or immobilizing support that cannot advance freely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In some usages, a double share of reward, or a corresponding double share of sin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a usage in some linguistic varieties; it is broader than the specifically Quranic contexts represented above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who abstains from eating, or one who joins or continues fasting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A recognized but etymologically uncertain lexical usage, explicitly reported as valid in speech.

cautions: The reading of 3:37 varies: one reading presents Zakariya as made responsible for Mary, while another presents him as undertaking her care; this is reflected in the Form II usage conditions.
كِفْلَيْنِ in 57:28 is interpreted either as two portions of mercy or as a continuing, sufficient blessing; both interpretations are covered by the Quranic share sense.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The QAC occurrences at 21:85 and 38:48 occur in the expression Dhul-Kifl. The supplied lexical evidence does not establish whether كِفْل there retains one of the common-noun senses or functions only as an unresolved proper-name element.
